scenarios.title: New user signs up and lands on dashboard
scenarios.narrative: Brand new user fills the signup form, confirms via the test inbox, lands on an empty dashboard.
scenarios.expected: After confirming the email, the user lands on an empty dashboard with a 'Create your first project' CTA.
scenarios.notes: Mistyped the email once, corrected it. No real email sent — used MailHog test inbox at :8025.

scenarios.title: User creates their first project
scenarios.narrative: From the empty dashboard, user opens the New Project modal, names it, picks a template, and lands inside the project view.
scenarios.expected: After clicking 'Create', the modal closes immediately and the project view loads.
scenarios.observed: The success toast appeared but the modal stayed on screen for ~600ms before closing. I hovered the cursor as if confused while waiting.
scenarios.hypothesis: Modal close-on-success isn't tied to the same event as the toast — likely a stale setTimeout or a missing dispatch in the New Project modal's submit handler. Look at the modal's onSubmit path.

scenarios.title: User invites a collaborator by email
scenarios.narrative: From inside a project, user opens Share, enters a teammate email, sets role to Editor, and sends the invite.
scenarios.expected: After clicking 'Send invite', a toast confirms the invite was sent and the teammate appears in the Members list as 'Pending'.
scenarios.observed: Clicking Send did nothing visible — no toast, no list update, no modal close. I clicked again, still nothing. No on-screen error.
scenarios.hypothesis: Invite POST is failing silently with no user-visible error. DevTools showed POST /api/invite returned 500. Two issues: the backend handler is broken AND the frontend swallows the error instead of surfacing a toast for 5xx responses.
scenarios.notes: Backend tests pass but the user-facing flow is broken.
